warnings: RESOLVES the CX column-position question flagged on หน้า15 (S-02). แบบขยาย (ค) draws the CX steel column sitting DIRECTLY on the RC pedestal (เสาตอม่อ, ดูแบบขยาย C1) with the B2 beam framing into that joint, and dimensions the 1.20 m as the length of B2 running out BEYOND the pedestal. So the column is ON grid ค / ก (where S-01 shows its footing) and the 1.20 m is a cantilever of the B2 beam, not a column offset. Reading (b) confirmed; the cx_offset_from_grid_unconfirmed flag on หน้า15_view1 has been cleared.

This sheet is all connection details, so elements carry no grid_ref -- they are referenced from the plans by their Thai detail letters (ก/ข/ค/ง) and by the section mark X-X, matching the callouts printed on S-02 and S-03.

The detail letters on this sheet are Thai characters used as DETAIL IDs (แบบขยาย ข, ค, ง), which look identical to the y-axis GRID names (ก, ข, ค) used on the plans. They are unrelated namespaces -- do not join a detail letter to a grid line.

'เหล็ก ⌷ N มม.' denotes a flat steel plate of that thickness (gusset / stiffener / base plate); the symbol is a plate mark, not a channel. Recorded verbatim in members[] because the schema has no plate field.

The steel stair detail gives 4 risers at 0.20 m (0.80 m total rise) and 4 treads at 0.375 m (1.50 m total run) with checker-plate treads to the architectural drawings -- this is the entrance stair whose framing appears unlocated on S-02 (the 'โครงเหล็กรับบันได C100x50x5x7.5 มม.' note).
แบบขยาย (ก), called out twice on S-03, is NOT on this sheet -- it is drawn on S-07 (หน้า20), the T1 truss sheet, as a column-splice detail. Confirmed 2026-07-25; no drafting error.
